name: Rank in Google and AI search
blurb: Audit the site, fix what blocks ranking, then plan and write the content that Google and AI answers cite.
description: Grow organic and AI search traffic from one request: a technical audit with fixes, keyword and intent research, topic clusters and internal links, writing or refreshing articles, schema and AI search signals, and a link plan, using the Skill Garden seo and content-creation super skills in order. Use when asked to improve SEO, rank higher, get cited in ChatGPT or AI Overviews, or plan a content engine for a site.
ask: Grow search traffic for <site> on <topic or product>.
inputs: The site and its most important pages
Who searches and what they buy
Access you have: Search Console, analytics, the CMS
How many articles a month you can publish

steps.title: Audit the site
steps.output: Issues ranked by impact (crawling, indexing, speed, duplicates) with the fix for each.

steps.title: Research keywords and intent
steps.output: Topic clusters with the intent, difficulty and the page that should rank for each.

steps.title: Plan the structure and links
steps.output: Hub and supporting pages, their URLs and the internal links between them.

steps.title: Write or refresh the articles
steps.output: The first articles, written for the reader, with titles and meta descriptions.

steps.title: Schema and AI search signals
steps.output: JSON-LD per page type, AI crawler settings and passages written to be quoted.

steps.title: Plan links and tracking
steps.output: A 90-day link plan and the reports to check each month.
